## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain what changes and why. Link a related issue if applicable.

## Validation

State commands actually run, platform and results. Distinguish component checks, compiled C++ objects and native browser execution.

## Visuals or limitations

Include safe captures for visual changes and identify native versus component/concept images. Note remaining platform or release limitations.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and uses English project documentation/commit text.
- [ ] Relevant checks passed; omitted checks and known failures are explained above.
- [ ] Documentation and license notices are updated where needed.
- [ ] No credentials, personal profiles, generated checkout trees or build artifacts are included.
